title: TimeCop
wikitext:
It all started with Duke Nukem, played for 2 weeks, and then just abandoned it (got tired of chasing through endless corridors and shooting brainless monsters).

Later I switched to Quake. And my dear stump did not let me down. However, later, having become addicted to TF, I realized what a bad connection is. Sometimes I had to sniper with a ping of 600 - 700. But nothing, I didn't complain: I played even through IBM Net.

I love good old Russian rock, computers, Team Fortress, night Internet and wandering around Moscow at night in the rain.
